data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (prior-year comparative, 2018) is GBP 259.79m. The year-end gross outstanding claims increased materially to GBP 587m (2019 year-end) according to the report narrative; this movement appears to reflect transactions during 2019 (including a reinsurance-to-close and related reinsurance arrangements) rather than a straightforward development-release/strengthening read-across for prior underwriting years. The report includes a gross claims development triangle (underwriting years 2011-2018) but the scanned images do not allow reliable extraction of the prior-year re-estimation amount for 2017 and earlier, so a quantified gross prior-year development figure could not be determined from the available pages.
raw_causal_phrases: Total outstanding claims gross of reinsurance, were GBP 587 million as at 31 December 2019 (2018: GBP 260 million)
the increase in outstanding claims and cash balances predominantly arises as a result of transactions concluded in 2019
data.data_quality_notes: Scanned images were low resolution in places. Opening gross claims outstanding (2018 comparative) was located in the balance sheet and corroborated by narrative (2018: GBP 259.79m) - high confidence. A clear, explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding) could not be unambiguously located or reliably read from the scanned notes. A gross claims development triangle appears in the notes (underwriting years 2011-2018) which could be used to compute prior year development, but the numeric cells could not be extracted with confidence from the provided images. The syndicate accepted a reinsurance-to-close / transfer in the period (document references), which likely distorts simple comparisons; this further reduces confidence in any attempted PYD numeric extraction from the triangle. No reliable gross premium total or segmental premium mix could be extracted from the scanned pages with sufficient certainty.
